before.reasoning: Appears to support sanctuary city policies and protection of immigrant communities in LA, consistent with his overall progressive-to-moderate positioning on social issues. Detailed positions on local ICE cooperation were not publicly detailed.

after.reasoning: No public record found on local immigration enforcement. Acosta's only stated position on federal relations is that he will "work with the White House when it benefits Los Angeles and push back hard when it doesn't" — a general posture toward federal cooperation that takes no position on ICE detainers, on sharing immigration status information with federal agencies, or on the use of local police resources for immigration enforcement.

rows.why: REFUTED BY THE EVIDENCE, not merely unsupported. The old text inferred sanctuary support from his 'overall progressive-to-moderate positioning', with no quote; his actual words in the LAist guide are 'I'll work with the White House when it benefits Los Angeles and push back hard when it doesn't', which is not sanctuary advocacy. The attribute-prior class (1521) caught BEFORE publication rather than after — the orphan cohort's whole point.
rows.not_retired_because: The row is a real research artifact with a real citation, and what he actually said is worth recording. Corrected to the honest documented blank it should always have been, which is why it leaves the ORPHAN_CONTEXT queue by the same carve-out that exempts every other documented blank.
